ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

4. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

5. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

6. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

7. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

8. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

9. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

2. D — Information and Communication Technology

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

10. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

12. D — CPU

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Digital Electronics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
